content.name: Power Word Stun
entries: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is {@condition stunned}. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.
The {@condition stunned} target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, this stunning effect ends.

content.name: Power Word Stun
entries: You overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range. If the target has 150 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or fewer, it has the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition. Otherwise, its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is 0 until the start of your next turn.
The {@condition Stunned|SRD52} target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.
